name: Knock
description:
Knock is infrastructure for product and customer messaging. This connector gives Claude access to your Knock account, so you can design, inspect, and manage notification workflows without leaving chat.

With Knock connected, Claude can explore and call the Knock Management API for both read and write operations via Code Mode tools. It can also create and update workflows, broadcasts, guides, email layouts, partials, and translations with the hosted Knock agent, as well as inspect environments, messages, users, tenants, and objects when those capabilities are enabled.

Authentication is handled through your Knock account using OAuth. When connecting, you can choose which capabilities to grant so Claude only receives the level of access you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Knock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Knock to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.knock.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Knock MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Knock provides these MCP tools: execute_mapi_read, execute_mapi_write, get_knock_agent, search_mapi, and start_knock_agent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Knock?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Knock in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Knock requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Knock is developed by Knock. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
